title: The Health Hideout
caption:
We're helping to bring the world's best hyperbaric chambers to every part of the UK.

A new Atlantis Plus at The Health Hideout in Albrighton, Shropshire.

Great project to be part of. Matte black with the Health Hideout logo on the shell. We love the contrasting dark seats and light honeycomb interior. Chamber + plant in one room works perfectly when the equipment looks this good.

Chamber by @hpotech.hyperbaric
